About Us

Welcome to Khau Gully Express — where the vibrant flavors of Indian streets meet modern vibes!

Inspired by the bustling food lanes (gullies) of India, we bring some of the most loved street-food flavors straight to the streets of DFW. From flavorful Paneer Frankies and classic Bombay Sandwiches to sizzling Tawa Pulao and a comforting cup of Chai, our menu is all about bold flavors, fresh ingredients, and food that hits the spot.

At Khau Gully Express, we believe street food is more than just a quick bite — it's about the experience, the conversations, and the memories created around great food.

Our goal is simple: serve delicious Indian street food with a fresh, modern twist and good vibes every time.

Come hungry. Leave happy. And experience the taste of the gully!
